items.title: vercel's agent-desktop leads github trending with 2,275 stars
items.summary:
agent-desktop gives agents reliable control of desktop apps by reading each app's accessibility tree instead of guessing from screenshots.
it added 2,275 stars today to reach 10,243 and sits first on github trending, with rust underneath and computer-use cli as the pitch.

items.title: claude-mem adds 1,803 stars as the memory layer for coding agents
items.summary:
claude-mem captures what an agent does in a session, compresses it with a model and injects the useful parts into later sessions.
it added 1,803 stars today to reach 110,878 and sits second on github trending, with a palette of hooks for claude code, codex and other agents.

items.title: scrapling adds 706 stars for scraping everything from one request to a full crawl
items.summary:
scrapling is a python scraping framework that handles a single fetch, stealth browser sessions and full crawls behind one api.
it added 706 stars today to reach 93,116 and sits third on github trending, with its last push on monday evening.

items.title: hyprland returns to trending with 509 stars for the independent wayland compositor
items.summary:
hyprland is a tiling wayland compositor built independently of the big desktop projects, known for animation and heavy customisation.
it added 509 stars today to reach 40,002, the only non-ai repo in the top five and a reminder that desktop tooling still moves fast.

items.title: claude-code-game-studios adds 1,379 stars for a 49-agent studio
items.summary:
the repo turns claude code into a game studio: 49 agents, 72 workflow skills and a coordination layer modelled on real studio roles.
it added 1,379 stars today to reach 33,712 and held fifth on github trending even though it was last pushed in mid-october.

items.title: freetoken adds 653 stars for datacenter-scale model serving on a desktop
items.summary:
freetoken is a serving stack from flashml that aims to run large models locally at datacenter speeds instead of renting gpu time.
it added 653 stars today to reach 16,165 and entered the trending page at sixth, with a commit as recently as 02:05 riyadh.

items.title: t3code has the biggest star gain of the day at 3,229
items.summary:
t3code is an agent control surface that drives claude code, codex, cursor, grok build and opencode from one app.
it added 3,229 stars today to reach 42,242; github lists it seventh on the page despite the largest daily gain.

items.title: kronos adds 857 stars for a foundation model of financial markets
items.summary:
kronos is a foundation model trained on market data that treats price series as a language, aimed at forecasting and regime work.
it added 857 stars today to reach 46,059, still drawing traffic months after its last push in april.

items.title: us strikes iran's qeshm island in what officials call a defensive hit
items.summary:
us officials told the wall street journal that american aircraft hit targets on qeshm island on monday, and fox news said it came after iran fired at a us aircraft.
iranian state media reported explosions on qeshm and at bandar lengeh, while centcom did not respond to requests for comment.
items.change: the first confirmed us strike on iranian territory since the doha round began, after weeks of signals that washington would wait until after the midterms.

items.title: trump says no to more strikes on iran and says a deal could happen
items.summary:
asked on monday whether he was considering new strikes after the midterms, trump said no, and that an agreement with iran could happen.
he repeated that tehran will never be allowed a nuclear weapon, while vance said the two sides had good conversations and no deadline was set.
items.change: a direct walk-back of the post-midterm strike threat he had been hinting at for weeks, on the eve of the vote.

items.title: doha talks stay alive as vance reports progress and iran says the ball is with washington
items.summary:
vance said the us and iran had a number of good conversations and that he and trump feel good about a negotiated settlement, with no deadline.
tehran says washington must lift the blockade, ease sanctions and cut its regional force posture before any deal; qatar has not announced a new round.
items.change: the doha round ended without a deal, but washington now publicly calls the talks progress while tehran says the next move is american.

items.title: israel's opposition leaders meet jointly for the first time since the election
items.summary:
eisenkot, bennett, liberman, golan and lapid meet on tuesday morning, with the opposition bloc converging on eisenkot for prime minister.
herzog begins consultations with the smallest knesset factions on wednesday; liberman also backed lapid for speaker.
items.change: the opposition bloc has now united behind eisenkot in public, one day before herzog's consultations formally begin.

items.title: saudi air defences intercept a houthi missile as fighting grinds on in al-jawf
items.summary:
the saudi-led coalition said it destroyed a ballistic missile aimed at the kingdom's south on monday, after downing a drone on sunday night.
houthi media reported seven wounded in coalition strikes on hodeidah, while yemen's army says its al-jawf push killed about 500 fighters in 24 hours.
items.change: the coalition reported intercepts on two straight nights while the government's al-jawf campaign widened toward marib and al-bayda.

items.title: two projectiles hit a tanker off ras al-khafji as hormuz attacks continue
items.summary:
ukmto says two unidentified projectiles struck a tanker's port side 72 nautical miles east of ras al-khafji late on sunday, with all crew accounted for.
it followed a mayday from another vessel in the strait, and oman's navy has evacuated 25 crew from the burning panama-flagged riti.
items.change: another night of strikes on commercial shipping despite the doha talks, this time close to the saudi coast and with a second vessel in distress.

items.title: s&p 500 slips 0.5% and nasdaq drops 1.1% as the tech selloff resumes
items.summary:
the s&p 500 closed at 7,541.40 and the nasdaq composite at 25,164.36, while the dow rose 0.4% to 51,983.98 as money rotated out of tech.
the nasdaq-100 fell 1.4% to 27,989.82, its third correction this year, and the vix jumped 8.9% to 21.15.

items.title: brent falls 7.6% to $104.77 as traders price in an iran deal
items.summary:
brent settled at $104.77 and wti at $96.46, drops of 7.6% and 7.4%, after trump and pezeshkian both talked up a diplomatic path.
wti's fall was its biggest daily loss since 27 july; brent edged back to $104.82 after the qeshm strike report.

items.title: apple beats but warns memory costs will squeeze the holiday quarter
items.summary:
apple beat fiscal fourth-quarter estimates on iphone and services and forecast its biggest revenue quarter ever.
the stock fell nearly 3% after hours after management said memory costs and siri ai spending will weigh on holiday margins.

items.title: palantir's us commercial revenue overtakes government for the first time
items.summary:
palantir reported revenue above $2bn, nearly double a year ago, with net income of $1.13bn or 44 cents a share.
us commercial revenue rose 148% to $984m against $953m from government, and the company guided to about $8.53bn for the full year.

items.title: amd and amgen headline a heavy tuesday earnings slate
items.summary:
shopify, pfizer, ferrari, marathon petroleum, eaton and apollo report before the open on midterm day.
amd, amgen, arista, booking, aig and block report after the close, with amd the main ai read-across.

items.title: midterms, jolts and factory orders fill tuesday's calendar
items.summary:
voters go to the polls while jolts job openings land at 18:00 riyadh, forecast at 7.13 million against 7.08 million last time.
factory orders are expected up 1.2% at the same hour, and the api publishes crude stocks after the close.

items.title: futures edge higher after the selloff while oil holds near $105
items.summary:
s&p 500 futures were up 0.02% and nasdaq-100 futures up 0.4% at 06:30 riyadh, with brent at $104.82.
the dollar was flat at 101.8, gold slipped to $3,947 and the 10-year yield held at 4.91%.

items.title: liverpool take a perfect champions league record to fenerbahce
items.summary:
liverpool have won all three league-phase games and can move close to early qualification with a win in istanbul on wednesday.
kick-off is 20:45 riyadh at sukru saracoglu, with clement turpin of france refereeing.

items.title: frimpong out and bradley still missing as iraola weighs another big rotation
items.summary:
frimpong is out until after the international break and bradley has been sidelined since january, while leoni is due back in training this month.
alisson stays first choice despite his error against arsenal, and iraola is expected to rotate again for an eighth game in 29 days.

items.title: arsenal's first league win at anfield since 2012 leaves liverpool fifth
items.summary:
havertz scored the only goal after alisson's misplaced pass, and liverpool did not manage a shot on target.
the defeat ended a five-match winning run and left liverpool nine points behind the leaders.

items.title: former ref keith hackett says timber should have been sent off at anfield
items.summary:
hackett, a former fifa and premier league referee, says jurrien timber's shirt pull on isak was a clear penalty and a red card.
the echo reports his view that var should have sent andy madley to the monitor; iraola called the isak incident a clear penalty.

items.title: gravenberch's bench role grows as nyoni makes his case in midfield
items.summary:
gravenberch was an unused substitute against arsenal, the first time he has not played a minute in an available premier league game since april 2024.
nyoni started his first premier league game and says iraola is deliberately moving him between the six and the eight.

items.title: ngumoha on standby for istanbul as iraola considers moving araujo to right-back
items.summary:
with frimpong out, gomez and szoboszlai are right-back options and araujo could shift there, which opens a rotation path for ngumoha.
tsimikas, with three assists in his last two champions league starts, is pressing kerkez at left-back.

items.title: spanish media tell trent to accept a squad role at real madrid
items.summary:
spanish coverage argues trent alexander-arnold should settle for third-choice status, a line sourced to press opinion rather than anything from liverpool.
no reliable outlet has linked liverpool with a replacement, so treat the story as low-reliability noise.

items.title: crystal palace away next in the league, then manchester united at anfield
items.summary:
liverpool go to selhurst park on sunday after istanbul, with the manchester united game at anfield to follow.
the carabao cup quarter-final against bournemouth at anfield is also in the diary.
